page.layout: One page of title text, centred. From top to bottom: the author's name in capitals; the title in large capitals; "Pars Secunda" in italic; an engraving of a tree with a banner reading "NON SOLUS" and a figure beside it; the imprint in three lines; the year in Roman numerals; "Cum Privilegio" in italic at the foot.
page.notes: The engraving shows a tree with spreading branches, a figure in a long robe standing at its right, and a scroll banner across the trunk reading "NON SOLUS", with a ground line of plants below. The banner words are part of the woodcut and are transcribed as a line in reading order. The "Cum" of the last line is printed with a small raised letter that is hard to see on the scan; it is copied as "Cum". The "Ubbonis" heading begins with a capital printed as V; it is given as U because it is a vowel. The page is otherwise clean, with show-through from the reverse page visible at the edges, which is not transcribed.
